C9000029.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 029 (Primitive roots for every admissible integer base.; papers: Primitive roots for every admissible integer base; Simultaneous primitive roots: a conditional lower bound for prime bases; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_REFLECTION_AUDIT.statement: Settle whether the declared cover, Whittaker normalization, reflected expansion, and quadratic sieve justify prop:reflection, by a source-faithful obstruction or an all-parameter proof.

C_PRIMARY_MAIN.statement: For every integer a other than -1 or an integer square, at least c_a x/(log x)^2 primes in every sufficiently large (x,2x) have ord_p(a)=p-1.

C_PRIMARY_CONTROLLED.statement: For the stated fixed progression data M,c,u, there are many primes p=crQ+1 with Q>x^0.9 and all prime factors of r between exp((log x)^0.1) and exp((log x)^0.3).

C_PRIMARY_SPLITTING.statement: For fixed |a|>1 and the stated growing primes q, the number of primes in (x,2x] splitting completely in Q(mu_q,a^(1/q)) is O_a(x/(q(q-1)log x)+x^(1-10^-6)).

C_PRIMARY_ZERO_FREE.statement: For every cyclotomic F containing mu_12 and every finite-order Hecke character eta, L_F(s,eta) has no zeros in Re(s)>1-10^-6, without a conductor or height cutoff.

C_REFLECTION.statement: For all epsilon>0, Z>=2 and dyadic P,D>=1, the B_m(Z) squared mass on the specified compact balanced annular rows is O(Z^epsilon P^(1/2)(D+D^2P/Z)).

C_ARITHMETIC.statement: The fixed S-integer generator convention has E direct-sum B power classes, exact exterior sextic reciprocity, the declared Gauss correction characters, and the zero extension on every nonunit including zeroth powers.

C_THETA_INPUT.statement: The stated c=2 cubic cover and exceptional datum give a genuine automorphic theta representation with the exact lifts, local spherical values, local uniqueness and complex behavior declared in prop:theta-input.

C_COVER_DATUM.statement: The determinant-modified c=2 threefold GL_2 cover descends through the ordinary split scalar subgroup, with the specified exceptional central character and compatible root, torus, compact and rational lifts.

C_REFLECTION_ALGEBRA.statement: For every prime power q congruent to 1 modulo 12, an order-six residue character chi with the manuscript additive convention, and the declared exceptional Jacquet model, the three shell classes give W_(3k)=q^(-k), W_(3k+1)=q^(-k-1)G_2 and W_(3k+2)=0 for every k>=0. Every masked exponent j modulo 6 has the stated local Weyl transform, with R(j,e+3,t)=q^(-1)R(j,e,t) for e>=1, the stated distinct e=0 formula, and unit exponent 1-4=3 giving the quadratic row-column pairing. The identities include zeroth-power masks and all unrestricted cube valuations; this is a supplied-data algebra theorem, not an unconditional analytic moment bound.

C_WHITTAKER_NORMALIZATION.statement: At every exterior prime, W(a(p^(3k)))=q^-k, W(a(p^(3k+1)))=q^(-k-1/2)g_2, W(a(p^(3k+2)))=0, negative valuations vanish, and units contribute chi(u)^(2e).

C_GLOBAL_FACTORIZATION.statement: The nonzero global Whittaker functional factors with normalized spherical exterior factors, consistently with the KP correction, and gives the stated rational Fourier expansion.

C_LOCAL_PROFILES.statement: The finite torus cutoff and all fixed complex derivative/Weyl-rotated Whittaker functions satisfy the norm-sheet bounds used in reflection.

C_GAUSSIAN_SMOOTHING.statement: The common radial profile V admits the exact Gaussian averaging kernel with all absolute moments, with Mellin convention Khat(-s)=exp(s^2)/Vhat(s).

C_MASKS_AND_LOCAL_WEYL.statement: For all valuation classes j mod 6 and every numerator valuation, the Fourier masks and local Weyl calculation have the support and monomial exponents stated in lem:reflection-local-Weyl.

C_REFLECTED_EXPANSION.statement: The full reflected expansion holds for every nonzero row, including independent unit classes, shared primes, powerful rows, unrestricted cubes, and active or inactive masked zeroth powers; its only unfrozen row-column pairing is quadratic.

C_QUADRATIC_SIEVE.statement: The primitive quadratic Kummer characters attached to allowed squarefree exterior generators satisfy Goldmakher-Louvel Definition 1 and hence the (C+D)(CD)^epsilon quadratic large sieve.

C_MOMENT_SUMMATION.statement: The all-parameter tail, frozen-exponent, cube and powerful-ideal estimates turn the full reflected expansion and quadratic sieve into the claimed dyadic mass bound.

C_POISSON.statement: Poisson summation and the Euler-product calculation isolate the principal double residue with a holomorphic nonvanishing correction to 1/L^S(s,eta).

C_ZERO_DETECTION.statement: The primitive conductor sieve and zero detector control all nonprincipal Poisson frequencies with the saving used in the comparison.

C_MELLIN_CONTINUATION.statement: The principal comparison integral has the stated power saving, and its shifted Mellin transform excludes zeros of the target L-function.

C_SECONDARY_MAIN.statement: Conditional on the four explicitly stated inputs, every fixed finite list of distinct positive prime bases are simultaneously primitive roots at at least c_q x/(log x)^2 primes in every sufficiently large (x,2x).

C_SECONDARY_RESERVOIR.statement: Conditional on marked Type II, block sieve and rough density, the secondary fixed-progression reservoir contains many primes p=4rQ+1 with the stated factor ranges.

C_SECONDARY_SPLITTING.statement: Conditional on the uniform Hecke zero-free input, the secondary order-obstruction count satisfies x/(ell(ell-1)log x)+x^(1-10^-6) for the stated controlled primes ell.

C_INPUT_HECKE.statement: The secondary Input input:hecke assumes the primary conductor- and height-unrestricted zero-free assertion; it is a hypothesis, not a result proved by the secondary paper.

C_INPUT_MARKED.statement: The marked Type II coefficient criterion and rough coefficient cancellation hold with their stated fixed-parameter, character, frequency and interval uniformities.

C_INPUT_BLOCK.statement: The block sieve has its stated uniform constants and unweighted squarefree remainder sum, including the H=2 upper bound.

C_INPUT_DENSITY.statement: The rough-number density satisfies the stated least-factor integral identity and exponentially accurate e^(-gamma_E)/b upper bound.
